path: GameLibrary/项目管理与测试/质量保证/自动化测试/校对模型的测试集，为什么要在生成错字之前划分.md
question: When typo variants share an original dialogue line, what must remain outside training to evaluate unseen original lines?

sources.author: 立福 寛 / Cygames
sources.title: AIによる自然言語処理を活用したゲームシナリオの誤字検出への取り組み
sources.read_scope: Slide text 21–22 and 34–37; slide 35 diagram visually inspected independently.
claims: Old pipeline augments original game text before shuffling/splitting; diagram warns that derivatives of the same original occur on both sides.
New pipeline partitions original scenario data before adding errors separately.
limits: No split-only ablation supports attributing score change to this repair.
No claim that all repeated lines or templates were isolated.
No assumption of GroupKFold use, current deployment, natural-error coverage or unseen-project performance.

sources.author: scikit-learn developers
sources.title: Cross-validation: evaluating estimator performance
claims: Evaluation of unseen groups requires groups excluded from the corresponding training fold.
GroupKFold enforces supplied group separation; group definition remains a data-design responsibility.
Test data used to choose settings is no longer an untouched final evaluation.

sources.author: scikit-learn developers
sources.title: Common pitfalls and recommended practices: Data leakage
claims: Split before learned preprocessing; fit only on training data.
Pipelines help control fitted preprocessing leakage but do not identify shared source lines.

localization_comparison.existing_reader: GameLibrary/本地化与无障碍/本地化制作/内容协作/原文未变时哪些语境变化需要重新翻译.md
localization_comparison.decision: Do not publish a new dialect/localization article from this material.
localization_comparison.reason: Japanese original-writing assistance and qualitative character-specific phrasing feedback do not add a distinct method beyond the existing context/review reader. No verified stale-reference conflict or acceptance procedure.

adjacent_proofreading_feedback.finding: Reviewer feedback distinguishes suspected typo from intentional decorative expression and ambiguous readings. This was a research lead, not evidence of accuracy or a standalone new reader.

selection_history.novelty_result: Predictive evaluation with augmented samples is distinct from automated action/verdict checks and causal player-assignment randomization. Repository keyword search found no indexed matches for 训练集 or 校对, which is supporting search evidence rather than proof of absence.

distinct_localization_candidate.read_scope: Independent visual inspection of English slides 1, 9 and 16 only.
distinct_localization_candidate.finding: Slide16 proposes project-specific nonstandard spelling rules to convey rhythm, speed and phonetics and distinguish character voices; no claim of measured success.
distinct_localization_candidate.decision: Retain as a distinct candidate; no reader publication until actual rules and examples are inspected.
distinct_localization_candidate.remaining_scope: English slides17–23 and, if needed,24–33. No inferred examples, stereotype rationale, audio similarity or reader-effectiveness claim.

original_example.method: Eight authored strings from four known source lines. Compare a variant-level split with a source-level split.
original_example.result_summary: Both arrangements have 4 rows and 2 changed rows per side, and no exact text overlap. Shared source IDs are A/B/C/D in the first and none in the second.
original_example.scope: Known identity/count verification only; not semantic independence, labeling validity or model performance.

limitations: No model training, engine run, natural-error corpus evaluation or human test.
No third-party slide image or dataset redistributed.
A known-line/new-error evaluation may legitimately share source lines if its narrower objective is stated.
Source-level isolation does not settle repeated text under different IDs, templates, chapter/project/time grouping, pretraining exposure or test-driven tuning.
